lessons: Requisition review failed on the plan, not the diff: section 20 fences retro-doctor-cli but never specifies its behavior (verbs, output, exit codes, reads). A seed that cites only section 20 therefore has no contract to implement.

Sections 18, 19 and 20 disagree about what doctor is. Section 18 calls it a mechanical self-check (venv, git, config, lock, journal). Section 19 says Phase 5 adds both retro and doctor verbs. The authored ticket made doctor a retro-window view and left out the retro verb.

Fix section 20 first: give retro-doctor-cli a closed behavior contract (the verbs to add to __main__.py, their output, exit codes and allowed reads), in line with sections 18 and 19. Then re-author phase5-continue-03 from the fixed plan.

The doctor seed's acceptance criteria must test feature behavior. Checks on the Context/on-demand partition and synthetic byte sizes belong in tests/test_seeded_phase5_03.py, not in tests/test_doctor.py.
Keep the prior lessons: don't create tickets/phase5-exit/ticket.md. Context stays squatch/retro.py and tests/test_retro.py for the doctor, and only tests/test_seeded_phase5_02.py for continue-04.
reason: The ticket requires a seed citing section 20 alone, but section 20 gives retro-doctor-cli no behavior contract and the plan contradicts itself about doctor, so only a plan fix (outside this fence) can unblock it.
